Entries.Original: Both 31-A and 31-B completed training without any issues. Good work, everyone.
Great work today, cadets. Don't lose the acuity you gained from this training.
Whoo-yeah! Our training days are finally over!
Not quite. Starting from tomorrow and continuing to the day after, you'll be doing a cumulative training covering content from all previous sessions, back-to-back.
Huh?! But didn't you say today was the last day of training?!
We need to do a final check of all training parameters. Don't get too carried away just because you were able to finish Phase Five.
Can I get carried away just for today?
Well, I suppose you could celebrate your efforts. Just for today.
31-A was overwhelmed by the Cancers' force and failed to prevent their advance.
Enemies infiltrated the bridgehead, so Point Delta had to be abandoned. The operation was a failure.
*sigh*... Unfortunately, you leave me with no other option than to conclude that 31-A is unsuitable for this mission.
We'll need to do a complete reconfiguration of the squadron.
